# Rule quality report - ITSM Workflow Intelligence tool

*Generated by `agent-layer/tests/rule_quality.js` - do not edit by hand.*

**Status (2026-10-10): whole-word matching, joining the observation and service WITH a space, and the extra vocabulary (proposal B) were ADOPTED into the tool (decisions Q-1, Q-2, Q-4, approved by James). "BEFORE" is the original logic, "NOW" is what the tool does today.**

**How to read this.** Each labelled phrase says which team(s) an incident should go to, or whether payment / personal-data wording is really present (labels were written by intent, without looking at the rules' results, by Claude - they still need a practitioner's review). **Strict** = the suggestion is the best-fit team; **lenient** = any plausible team (or correctly no suggestion). The corpus and the adopted rules share an author, so NOW is optimistic, and the corpus deliberately over-represents hard cases.

## Pre-flight payment / personal-data keyword scans

```
pre-flight keyword scans (33 labelled phrases)
  BEFORE        handled correctly  15/33 (45%)  | payment-scan FP 6 FN 5; personal-data-scan FP 2 FN 5
  NOW (adopted) handled correctly  30/33 (91%)  | payment-scan FP 1 FN 0; personal-data-scan FP 0 FN 2
  ref: A        handled correctly  20/33 (61%)  | payment-scan FP 1 FN 6; personal-data-scan FP 0 FN 6
  ref: B        handled correctly  30/33 (91%)  | payment-scan FP 1 FN 0; personal-data-scan FP 0 FN 2
```

**payment-related scan** - BEFORE precision 57% / recall 62%; NOW 93% / 100%
* *Fired when it should not (before):* "Discard button misaligned"; "Scorecard dashboard slow to load"; "Cardiff office VPN down"; "Fundamentals course page returns 404"; "Cardinality alert noise in monitoring"; "Purchase order PDF layout broken"
* *Missed (before):* "Apple Pay declines"; "Direct debit run failed"; "BACS submission rejected"; "Payout batch late"; "Merchant settlement report missing"
* *Still wrong now:* "Purchase order PDF layout broken"

**personal-data-related scan** - BEFORE precision 78% / recall 58%; NOW 100% / 83%
* *Fired when it should not (before):* "Customer dataset loads slowly in the BI tool"; "Account numbering scheme document update"
* *Missed (before):* "Passport scans stored unencrypted"; "Home address shown to other users"; "National Insurance numbers in export"; "Date of birth visible in URL"; "Card data in logs after payment failure"
* *Still wrong now:* "Email address list leaked"; "Card data in logs after payment failure"

## Limits of this measurement

* Labels are one author's judgement; several phrases are marked with a note in the corpus.
* The corpus is small and deliberately includes the known substring traps; NOW was tuned by the author who wrote the corpus.
* Whole-word matching cannot stop a word that is simply ambiguous ("endpoint", "gateway", "release", "data", "version" mean different things in different incidents): the suggestion is a prompt, and the tool now shows the matched words and says so.
* Routing here ignores a user's own custom routing rules (they take priority in the tool, and keep substring matching because they are the user's own words).
